method: Curated project cases. Area is the published project, lease or site envelope, not necessarily direct permanent land take. Protected-area overlap is only numeric when explicitly published; otherwise null.

projects.name: Bhadla Solar Park
projects.pressure: Large contiguous solar build-out, roads, transmission and dust/water management in an arid ecosystem.
projects.protected_relation: No verified protected-area overlap figure in the cited project record.

projects.name: Pavagada Solar Park
projects.pressure: Land leasing at very large scale changes farming, grazing access and local livelihoods.
projects.protected_relation: Protected-area overlap not quantified; social and land-use effects are the principal documented sensitivity.

projects.name: Noor Ouarzazate Solar Complex
projects.pressure: Concentrated solar and PV infrastructure combine land occupation with water requirements in a water-stressed region.
projects.protected_relation: No numeric protected-area overlap published in the cited project summary.

projects.name: Lake Turkana Wind Power
projects.ecosystem: Arid pastoral landscape near Lake Turkana
projects.pressure: Turbines, roads and transmission occupy customary pastoral territory; the site envelope is much larger than the sealed footprint.
projects.protected_relation: The project is near a World Heritage landscape; a numeric overlap is not asserted here.

projects.name: Viking Wind Farm
projects.pressure: Peat excavation, roads and turbine foundations fragment carbon-rich blanket bog; restoration is required but residual effects remain monitored.
projects.protected_relation: Sensitive peat habitat is documented; protected-area overlap hectares are not published as a single verified value.

projects.name: Hornsea 2 Offshore Wind Farm
projects.ecosystem: North Sea seabed and marine habitat
projects.pressure: Turbine foundations, array cables, export corridor, vessel traffic and collision/displacement risk affect a wide marine envelope.
projects.protected_relation: Marine protected features were assessed through consenting; the full array area must not be read as destroyed seabed.

warnings: Project/site area is not equal to direct sealed footprint.
Offshore array area is a planning envelope, not hectares of seabed permanently occupied.
Null protected overlap means not verified in the selected source, not zero overlap.
Hectares per MW are descriptive ratios, not universal impact factors.
